description: USE WHEN you want the full framework, portfolio and stress evidence of one thesis slug. Returns the framework (pillars with [E]/[M]/[K] evidence grades, falsifiers), the rule-based portfolio (asset blocks x conservative/balanced/offensive weights + sizing rationale) and the stress evidence (per-tier backtest, per-regime drawdown, historical episodes, pre-registered verdicts, hedge behaviour). Slugs: list_investment_theses. Descriptive, not advisory; the agent decides suitability.

sections.description: Optional subset of ['framework', 'evidence', 'portfolio', 'bridge'] to return (default: all; framework and evidence are about 8k characters each, portfolio about 2k). The thesis identity, disclaimer and `holdings` are always included; `section_sizes` lists what each section would cost.
